scope: Proposition 6.1 (Consecutive square sizes) of the manuscript “The critical logarithmic correction for the planar XY model” (preprints/The-critical-logarithmic-correction-for-the-planar-XY-model-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5c357d1c416119fa), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 68. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix 0 < ϵ < 1/10. For all sufficiently large N, put n0 = LN , n1 = LN+1, and choose a power m′ = Lj′ so that DN = n0 m′ ≍ Nϵ , j′ = N − O(log N). (138) Use the entry history for N in both squares, and let tj′ be its unbalanced plane gradient coefficient at the stop. Then log Mn1 Mn0 = − 1 − tj′ 2a (gn1 − gn0 ) + O D4 N N2 + 1 NDN ! . (139) Moreover, for a constant cG, gLN = 2π(log L)N + cG + o(1). (140) All constants are independent of N.
